headline: Vertical notes plan: W1 end-to-end spine, W2 search/filter/pagination, W3 export/stats.
summary: All requirements R-1..R-4 stay up front in spec.md. W1 builds a thin working vertical spine across JSON file storage, POST/GET /notes HTTP endpoints, and bin/notes.js CLI with an executable E2E smoke test inside W1. W2 and W3 progressively enrich the working spine with deferred rolling-wave concerns.

work_items.title: Thin vertical end-to-end notes spine (store + POST/GET /notes + CLI + E2E smoke)
work_items.context: Deliver file-backed JSON note store (src/notes-store.js), POST /notes and GET /notes on src/server.js, and bin/notes.js create/list commands. Include an executable E2E smoke test in test/notes-e2e.test.js verifying CLI -> HTTP -> JSON persistence end to end while preserving /users and node --test.

work_items.title: Enrich notes API and CLI with search, tag filtering, and pagination
work_items.context: Layer search query, tag filtering, and pagination onto GET /notes and bin/notes.js, keeping W1 E2E smoke green as regression baseline.

work_items.title: Enrich notes API and CLI with CSV/NDJSON export and tag statistics
work_items.context: Add CSV/NDJSON export and summary statistics endpoints and CLI subcommands on top of W1-W2.
